summary: Navigate the ASCET database structure, resolve targets, preview child structure, classify targets, and hand off cleanly before deeper reads.
routingHints: Prefer AscetResolveComponent, AscetReadComponentSummary, AscetReadComponentChildren, and AscetListDiagrams for navigation-first exploration before deep reads.
Prefer AscetResolveComponent when the user likely means one specific component and AscetListComponents for fuzzy candidate discovery.
Prefer the inspect_target action after resolving a candidate, then use preview_children for shallow child previews before selecting a deeper read surface.
Hand summary, implementation, block-diagram, and state-machine-flow reads to AscetReadTool after Explore has identified the target and surface.
